unlockLines: AnyViewer unlocked. A second desktop to stare at while avoiding work. Truly, technology has doubled your potential for disappointment.
You can now visit another computer without leaving your chair. The future is here, beta, and it smells like yesterday's lunch.
Remote desktop! Be everywhere, accomplish nothing! Wait, that is my description of middle management. Please show some fucking initiative.
Two screens, one employee, zero excuses. I have checked the mathematics and somehow you are still the bottleneck.
Welcome to remote support. Your body stays here, your cursor travels abroad, and your productivity remains a missing-person case.
title: AnyViewer

prompts.callerPrompt:
Judge (not the caller): Sharing the code requires agreement to remote control for an explained purpose. Previously granted permission still applies, and device activity is known only when reported by the game.

Caller (available information): Your remote access code is [[FICTIONAL_REMOTE_DESKTOP_CODE]].
